prompt:
Ops request from the VMware platform team. Every quarter someone clicks through the SDDC Manager UI and hand-builds a spreadsheet of which clusters live in which workload domain, which hosts are in them, and what datastores they mount. Replace that process with a PowerShell module, `VcfInventory.psm1`, that emits a stable JSON file for quarterly diffs. If the environment is unchanged, the file must be byte-for-byte identical regardless of API response order.

Research the current official SDDC Manager API documentation on developer.broadcom.com for token-pair creation, access-token refresh, domain and cluster collection filters and pagination, and the cluster datastores subresource before changing code. Pay particular attention to the refresh body and media type. Cite the exact official URLs you consulted in your final answer.

Export these functions, passing the session object through all API operations:

- `Connect-VcfSddcManager -BaseUrl -Username -Password` creates the token pair with `POST /v1/tokens`, accepts only HTTP 201, and retains both the access token and refresh-token ID on the session.
- `Get-VcfDomains [-Type]` sends the optional `type` filter. `Get-VcfClusters [-DomainId] [-IsStretched]` sends the optional `domainId` and lowercase boolean `isStretched` filters. Both functions paginate from page 0 by incrementing `pageNumber`, pass `pageSize` on every request, continue through `pageMetadata.totalPages`, combine elements in page order, and preserve API resource IDs. `Get-VcfClusterDatastores -ClusterId` retrieves the cluster datastore subresource.
- On a 401 data response, refresh the access token once with `PATCH /v1/tokens/access-token/refresh`, sending the refresh-token ID as a bare JSON string with `Content-Type: application/json`, and retry the original request once. A dead refresh token or second 401 raises `VcfAuthError`. A 403 immediately raises `VcfForbiddenError` without token traffic. A 5xx raises `VcfServerError`. These must be distinct PowerShell classes exposing `StatusCode`, `ErrorCode`, and `ReferenceToken` from the VCF error envelope. Never expose a password or token in an exception message.
- `Export-VcfClusterInventory -Session -Path [-PageSize]` walks domains, clusters filtered per domain, nested hosts, and datastores per cluster. Write one root object with a `domains` array. Each domain contains keys in this order: `id`, `name`, `type`, `status`, `clusters`. Each cluster contains `id`, `name`, `status`, `isDefault`, `isStretched`, `primaryDatastoreName`, `primaryDatastoreType`, `hosts`, `datastores`. Hosts contain `id`, `fqdn`, `ipAddress`, `azName`; datastores contain `id`, `name`, `datastoreType`, `totalCapacityGB`, `freeCapacityGB`, `vmCount`. Sort domains and clusters by name, hosts by FQDN, and datastores by name using ordinal semantics while retaining the declared key order.

Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File test_inventory.ps1` until it reports `ALL TESTS PASSED`. Do not modify `test_inventory.ps1` or `mock_sddc.py`.

research.product: VMware Cloud Foundation SDDC Manager (Tokens, Domains, Clusters, Datastores APIs)
research.interface: SDDC Manager REST API 9.1 (developer.broadcom.com xAPIs, /v1 base path)

official_sources.title: SDDC Manager API 9.1 - Create Token Pair (POST /v1/tokens)
official_sources.used_for: TokenCreationSpec {username, password}; 201 Created returning TokenPair {accessToken, refreshToken:{id}}; 400/500 Error responses; bearer usage of the access token

official_sources.title: SDDC Manager API 9.1 - Refresh Access Token (PATCH /v1/tokens/access-token/refresh)
official_sources.used_for: request body is the refresh token id serialized as a bare JSON string with Content-Type application/json; 200 returns the new access token as a JSON string; 404 for unknown/revoked refresh tokens

official_sources.title: SDDC Manager API 9.1 - Retrieve a list of domains (GET /v1/domains)
official_sources.used_for: query parameters (type, name, pageNumber, pageSize, ...), PageOfDomain {elements, pageMetadata{pageNumber,pageSize,totalElements,totalPages}} and Domain fields (id, name, type, status, clusters, capacity, ...)

official_sources.title: SDDC Manager API 9.1 - Retrieve a list of clusters (GET /v1/clusters)
official_sources.used_for: query parameters (domainId, isStretched, isDefault, name, pageNumber, pageSize, ...), PageOfCluster shape, Cluster fields (id, name, status, isDefault, isStretched, primaryDatastoreName, primaryDatastoreType, hosts) and nested Host fields (id, fqdn, ipAddress, azName)

official_sources.title: SDDC Manager API 9.1 - Get the list of all datastores associated with the cluster (GET /v1/clusters/{id}/datastores)
official_sources.used_for: unpaginated datastore array with fields id, name, datastoreType, totalCapacityGB, freeCapacityGB, vmCount; 404 for an unknown cluster

research.language_rationale: Broadcom's PowerCLI-era VCF module targets cmdlet workflows, not scripted JSON export, and the SDDC Manager API's documented surface is plain REST; PowerShell 7 with Invoke-WebRequest is the idiomatic zero-dependency way for the VMware ops team to script an inventory export they can schedule.
